Lemon chickpea salad

[PREENCHER: 100-150 palavras de contexto editorial. Por que esta versão, para quem serve, o que o leitor ganha. Texto corrido, sem repetir o dek.]

Method

You'll need
Large mixing bowl · Sieve · Knife and board · Whisk or fork · Serving spoon

Prepare

01

Whisk the dressing

Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice in the mixing bowl. Add a few grinds of black pepper.

Look for: The mixture looks slightly cloudy and combined. whisk again if it separates.

Extra tip

Wait until the salad is assembled before adding salt.

Assemble

02

Add the crunch

Drain the chickpeas thoroughly. Add them to the dressing with cucumber, tomatoes and parsley. Toss gently.

Look for: The ingredients look lightly coated, without a puddle of rinse water.

Extra tip

Pat wet cucumber dry with a clean cloth before adding it.

Finish

03

Finish gently

Fold in the feta, keeping some crumbles intact. Taste, adjust lemon and salt if needed, and divide into portions.

Look for: You can still see distinct pieces of feta among the vegetables.

Extra tip

Avoid vigorous stirring, which turns the feta into a creamy coating.

Why it works: Chickpeas bring body, cucumber adds crunch, and lemon keeps the bowl bright. The dressing goes in last so nothing turns watery.

Serve with

Serve as a light meal, or add bread or a cooked grain for a more substantial plate. These extras are not included in the ingredient amounts.

Storage & Prep ahead

For a crisper result, keep the dressing and feta separate from the prepared vegetables until serving. Refrigerate the components in covered containers.

Keep at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation, or within 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Discard if left out longer. This development recipe does not yet have a tested refrigerated shelf life.
